stances.summary: Critiques AI bubble as manufactured reality built on deception
stances.quote:
These are the flimsy foundations of the AI bubble's hypernormalized reality. A lie told to will something into existence. And when it all collapses, we'll all ask how we ended up here. 

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Attacks AI infrastructure spending as fictional or economically untenable
stances.quote:
This reality-distortion field requires constant fuel, in the form of circular make-believe deals for compute and GPUs that are either fictional or untenable, all flowing from the largest company on the stock market.

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Compares AI hype to hypernormalization, condemns collective irrationality
stances.quote:
It's not just about being skeptical. The AI bubble is one of the most perfected forms of Adam Curtis' Hypernormalization. A hyper-effective reality-distortion field that makes rationality irrational, and cult-like slavishness a virtue. 

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Questions AI demand claims lacking substantive evidence beyond anecdotes
stances.quote:
The depressing thing is how effective it is - how rational people can repeat platitudes that AI is "changing the world" and that there's "crazy demand for AI compute," despite little evidence outside of anecdotes and vague company data.
www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Accuses NVIDIA of massive spending to maintain AI bubble facade
stances.quote:
Understanding the motives behind the trillions in spending requires you to shift your perception of the bubble from the financials toward perception management.  NVIDIA has invested billions to keep the facade alive.

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Argues AI valuation logic collapses under scrutiny
stances.quote:
The AI perception bubble is contingent on the notion that trillions of dollars can't be wrong, nor can those spending the trillions of dollars be wrong either.  This idea crumbles at the slightest bit of pressure. 

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Condemns unjustifiable AI valuations shielded by politeness and false authority
stances.quote:
We're told to trust insane valuations, even though they're wholly unjustifiable, on the basis that criticism is impolite and venture capitalists know what they're doing, something entirely unfounded. 

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Exposes AI bubble sustained by deceptive metrics and avoided questioning
stances.quote:
The AI bubble is a perception bubble, and its hype sustains by an acceptance of bogus, inherently deceptive numbers, while avoiding asking difficult questions - and ignoring inconvenient truths. 

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Dismisses AI growth as driven by subsidies and executive delusion, not utility
stances.quote:
The line dividing reality and kayfabe in tech is hype, not whether something actually exists or whether it has uses (or users). Growth has come from subsidies, peer pressure and executive psychosis.

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Argues AI proponents lack justification beyond growth projections
stances.quote:
What separates the AI bubble from previous exercises is the inability for its proponents to point to anything other than growth as reasons for its inevitability, or why it should become the status quo. 

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Indicts complicit media for enabling AI bubble's false reality
stances.quote:
The AI bubble is yet another exercise in perception management, facilitated by a compliant media, except the mediation of reality - in LLMs' capabilities and economics - is wider than it's ever been.

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...

stances.summary: Blames media complicity in tech bubbles fueling public distrust and extremism
stances.quote:
The media, having been a co-conspirator to Enron's rise along with the metaverse and NFTs, has never acknowledged its culpability. The end result is a crisis of confidence, and the rise of alternative demagogues.

www.wheresyoured.at/hyperscale-n...
